description: Implementation of SerializationService providing methods for obtaining serializers, serializing, and deserializing objects within the OpenMRS framework.

classes.name: SerializationServiceImpl
classes.description: Provides implementation of the SerializationService interface, managing serializers and providing serialization/deserialization functionalities for OpenMRS objects.

methods.name: getSerializer
methods.description: Retrieve the registered OpenmrsSerializer instance for a given class.

methods.name: getDefaultSerializer
methods.description: Obtain the default serializer, either from global property or fallback to SimpleXStreamSerializer.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serialize an object using the specified OpenmrsSerializer class.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Reconstruct an object from its serialized string representation using specified serializer.

methods.name: getSerializers
methods.description: Get a list of all registered serializers.

methods.name: setSerializerMap
methods.description: Set the map of serializer classes to their instances.

methods.name: setSerializers
methods.description: Set multiple serializers at once, updating the internal serializer map.
